skillFull: Slide to activate a Magnetic Aura and fill the gauge. Fill the gauge with Slides to fire Note Jellies and destroy obstacles. Level Up for more points for Note Jellies.
story:
Amidst all the sounds in the sizzling oven, Rockstar Cookie discovered the spirit of rock 'n' roll.

He realized that in order to move the audience one must not only be talented, but give a stunning performance as well. During the ceaseless tuning of his style, he came to master his signature Slide Blast technique.

Now he's a shining star amongst the Cookies.

costumes.info: Rockstar Cookie has come to the school for a special performance! Even with just a few accessories added to his uniform, Rockstar Cookie's unique star power shines through. He once declared to his classmates that he would become a famous star one day, and look-he did it! Bravo! The school's ultimate superstar!
